tip: Tujuh belasan is tujuh belas (17) plus -an – the suffix turns the date into the whole event: any August 17 festivity is acara tujuh belasan.
Before a verb, baru means 'only just', not 'new': baru belajar puasa = is only just learning to fast. As 'new', baru follows its noun instead.
The ter- in terjual means it happened with no doer named: habis terjual is literally 'used up, got sold' – sold out.
Doubling inside ber-...-an makes it mutual: bermaaf-maafan = forgive one another. Saling berkunjung uses saling = each other for the same job.
